note: A turn uses one work-time header above its process content with no horizontal divider rule. Before process content arrives a synthetic row shows the same label. Saved and streamed projections of the same turn share that header position; any process disclosure replaces their placeholders, and an interrupted turn with collapsible process uses that disclosure header to display its stopped status instead of adding a second elapsed-time row. The disclosure is available while running and defaults open; terminal completion and user interruption default it closed unless the user chose otherwise or a child still needs attention. Final assistant text stays outside the process and freezes its elapsed time without ending the turn.
changeNote: 2026-11-22: Removed horizontal hairline rules from turn disclosure headers, work placeholders, and stopped status rows, and unified interrupted turns with collapsible activity onto one stopped disclosure header across saved and live projections.

rules.elapsedBase: max((finalAssistantStartedAtMs ?? completedAtMs ?? now) - startedAtMs, 0), whole seconds
rules.rowShape: left-aligned muted label with tabular numerals and no horizontal rule
rules.livePlacement: above the first work item, after leading user, external and worktree rows
rules.liveOpener: only a user leading the live segment; follow-ups after existing work retain their arrival position even without steering metadata
rules.completionTransition: the same disclosure header remains in place while its process content collapses
rules.runningStateOwner: activeTurnId, including an empty continuation before its first content
